chunks: So We seized him and his hordes and threw them into the sea. Behold then how was the end of the wicked!
ai.seo_question: What happened to Pharaoh and his army after they were thrown into the sea?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine seizure of Pharaoh and his forces, emphasizing that their defeat was not merely military but a spiritual collapse of tyranny. The command to 'look' serves as a timeless lesson for believers to witness how Allah dismantles the structures of the oppressor, reinforcing the concept of *Adl* (Divine Justice) where the ultimate outcome favors the righteous. This event is often cited to illustrate the transient nature of worldly power when divorced from divine truth.
